summary: The get_figma_data tool built its Figma API URL from the fileKey and nodeId tool arguments, and the curl fallback ran that URL inside an exec() shell string, so a crafted argument ran shell commands on the host.

vulnerable.description: Curl fallback interpolates the tool-derived URL into exec()

safe.description: execFile with an argument array, and regex-pinned fileKey and nodeId

notes: Verified by diffing the published 0.6.2 and 0.6.3 tarballs: exec(`curl ... "${url}"`) became execFile("curl", args) and the zod schema gained regex constraints. The advisory lists CWE-77; the corpus files it under CWE-078, the class the rule reports.
